data.one_liner: A Flutter grid view that builds waterfall flow layouts quickly.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom grid view and sliver implementation that renders items in a waterfall (masonry) layout. Supports fixed cross axis count and max cross axis extent delegates with customizable spacing and garbage collection tracking.
use_when: You need a masonry or waterfall style grid layout in Flutter.
Items in your grid have variable heights.
avoid_when: You only need a standard uniform GridView where all items are the same size.
strengths: Supports both fixed cross axis count and max cross axis extent.
Provides callbacks for garbage collection and viewport tracking.
Handles custom last child layout types like footers or load-more items.
weaknesses: Depends on extended_list_library which might increase maintenance surface.
